head: 488046f92446b95ae5e41d56eb9252c8a8f5b868
claim: a person opens the browser example, sees each agent with "N of M enabled", signs an agent in from its own row, picks the one account it uses and its default model, and finds pay-per-use keys listed apart, never chosen

target.version: byokit browser example (examples/pwa) with @byokit/ui agentView, commit 488046f92446b95ae5e41d56eb9252c8a8f5b868

steps.start: The example PWA served by examples/pwa/serve.ts on loopback against the mockOpenAI stand-in, a fresh browser profile with no accounts, headless Chromium at 390x844 (2x) and 1280x800, light and dark.
steps: Open the home page and read the Agents list: Codex, Claude Code, Pi, OpenCode, Kimi Code and Mistral Vibe, each with its plan count (agents-list).
Open Codex and tap Sign in on its ChatGPT plan; the page moves to the ChatGPT card's device code, which is typed on the stand-in's OpenAI page.
Back on Agents, Codex shows the account umer@example.com In use; pick GPT-6 Sol under Default model, open Pay per use, reload, and open Codex again (agents-codex).
Close Codex and open Pi: the same account is listed Signed in but not chosen, with the other plans to sign in (agents-pi).
steps.result: Before anything is connected every agent reads 0 of N enabled and Mistral Vibe reads No plan sign-in. After the sign-in from Codex's row, Codex reads 1 of 1 enabled with umer@example.com In use, the note Codex uses umer@example.com., GPT-6 Sol kept across the reload, and Pay per use listing OpenAI API key with Charged per use to your OpenAI account, not startable. Pi reads 1 of 6 enabled, its radio unchecked and the note Pick the account Pi uses. The before frames are the base home with provider cards only. Exit 0, 0 page errors per the manifest.

verdicts.seen: The Agents page shows each agent with a count: Codex "1 of 1 enabled", Claude Code "0 of 1 enabled", Pi "1 of 6 enabled", OpenCode "1 of 3 enabled". Codex has a ChatGPT sign-in row with one account, "umer@example.com" marked "In use", and a "Default model" set to "GPT-6 Sol". Pay-per-use is a separate collapsed section listing the "OpenAI API key" apart from the chosen sign-in. The screenshot does not show the act of signing in, so that step is inferred from the static state.

This is the dark-theme version of the same Agents page. It shows "Codex 1 of 1 enabled", "Claude Code 0 of 1 enabled", "Pi 1 of 6 enabled" and "OpenCode 1 of 3 enabled". Codex lists "umer@example.com" as "In use" under ChatGPT, the default model is "GPT-6 Sol", and "Pay per use (1)" lists the "OpenAI API key" separately. The sign-in action itself is not visible.
